title: The timeline bar Easing sets picked segments too when keys are picked with them
goal: When a person Shift-picks some keys and some segments of the line together and chooses an ease in the timeline bar, only the keys change today; the mock says the bar sets the curve for everything picked, so the segments should take it as well, in one undo step.
notes: Left from the-value-graph-zooms-its-value-range-and-the-ti. Today TimelineDock.keyBar shows the per-key KeyEase list whenever keySelection.refs is non-empty, and the shared EasingCurve list (CurveRow.menu) only for segments alone. Mixing needs a decision on how a key ease and a segment curve combine: a segment curve rewrites the leaving half of its first key and the arriving half of its last (LayerMotion.curvingStretch), so applying both in one perform can fight. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-animate.html, Pick caption: The timeline bar Easing then names the curve and sets it for everything picked.
acceptance: With keys and segments picked together, the bar names one shared answer or Mixed
Choosing an ease there changes the picked keys and the picked segments, one undo step
A walk picks a key and a segment together and sets both from the bar at Next defaults

Wherever a person eases a key, a segment, a row or the bar, they see the same list of curves, or a decision card says why a key keeps its own shorter list (card filed on wherever-you-ease-a-key-a-segment-a-row-or-the-b, which owns the answer)

log.note: 2026-10-14 digest design review: the app eases from two different lists, a key's own (KeyEase) and a segment's (EasingCurve, the mock's ten curves and Draw a Curve). Today a key menu, a row's right-click Easing and the bar with keys picked show the first; a segment menu and the bar with only segments picked show the second; the Camera row shows none (camera-keys-ease-in-and-out-like-every-other-key). A person sees a different list depending on what they right-clicked. This task is where the two meet, so it settles which list a person sees; checklist item added.

Adversarial pass: the mock (video-animate.html) has ONE list on a key and a segment, a key carrying the curve leaving it, and its graph applies a curve to picked segments. The app's key list (Premiere's six) came from the user's 2026-09-23 tasks, and its Ease In means slow ARRIVAL where the curve list's Ease in means slow START. So which list a key shows is the user's call, not a runner's. Built the mock's answer for the mixed pick: once any segment is picked, the bar shows the curve list and a picked point counts as the segment it starts (the last key as the one arriving at it), all set in one perform. Keys alone keep the key list until the card is answered.

Checklist item 4 moved onto its own task wherever-you-ease-a-key-a-segment-a-row-or-the-b, blocked on a decision card (recommends one list, the mock's) with a brief, so this task can close on what shipped.
